parsed.rationale: The two initializers live in structurally distinct targets — `app:WatchXYC` (WXYC/WatchXYC/PlayerPage.swift) and `app:iOS` (WXYC/iOS/NowPlayingWidget/NowPlayingTimelineEntry.swift) — and carry different names and signatures: `NowPlayingEntry.init(_:)` vs `NowPlayingTimelineEntry.init(nowPlayingItem:recentItems:family:)`. The Jaccard similarity of 0.78 is driven by near-duplicate shape, but the types themselves serve platform-specific widget/timeline roles (watchOS player page vs iOS WidgetKit timeline entry) whose initializer arguments are necessarily platform-divergent. Both `fields_or_signature` arrays are empty, so there is no concrete shared member evidence to ground an extraction. Merging them would couple watchOS and iOS widget semantics without a demonstrable shared abstraction.
